classification.resume: This is a parliamentary record of a question session (Fragestunde) in the Swiss National Council (Nationalrat) on 25 September 2006, featuring a question by Susanne Leutenegger Oberholzer about an alleged insider trading suspicion involving a Swisscom board member. The document contains the speakers' names and the accession information for the parliamentary service records.
